visual.general_description: Two side-by-side laparoscopic operative views of gastro-gastric anastomosis construction and closure.
visual.detailed_description: A occupies the left half with stapling instruments and 3 CM label; B occupies the right half with a sutured tissue seam. Raw visible overlays and author procedure claims are separated for each panel.

panels.detailed_description: The left intraoperative color image is labeled A at lower-left. Pink/red moist tissue and tan/yellow lobulated tissue fill the field. A broad gray metallic stapling instrument enters from lower-left with its jaws beside tissue near the center; another metallic shaft crosses from upper-left. Dark thread/short line-like structures lie toward the center-right tissue seam, with small red surface patches and reflected white highlights. Yellow text across the top reads GASTRO-GASTRO ANASTOMOSIS and a second line 3 CM. Upper-left overlay reads 15 Feb 2023 11:52:04. Lower-right overlay reads REC and 11 mmHg. The pressure-like device overlay is not an independently documented patient blood pressure, and the image timestamp is not converted into a clinical chronology date.

visual.general_description: Single postoperative contrast study with four labeled gastrointestinal regions.
visual.detailed_description: A single circular grayscale/blue-tinted radiographic field with a thick black border lies on a pale background. A vertebral column is visible on viewer-left. Dark contrast outlines a narrow upper pouch, a curved mid-field channel and a larger lower rounded contrast-containing region, with a lateral leftward horizontal channel. Four black labels are printed: Gastric Pouch at upper-center, Native Stomach at mid-right, Duodenum at mid-left and Alimentary Limb on two lines lower-right. No arrows, calipers, axes, chart legend, independent transit time or calibrated diameter are visible. One static frame cannot independently verify the absence of a leak or the entire flow sequence.
